label: sportswars3
title_zh: 战争从未改变：抛蛋狂潮

lines.en: label sportswars3:
scene eggwar1

: Now that you’ve all had an hour or two to get acclimated and learn about how this year’s Dorm Wars-Slash-Sports Day is going to work, I’d like to open the floor to anyone who might have any questions!
lines.zh: : 既然你们已经有一两个小时适应环境、也了解了今年的「宿舍大战兼运动会」要怎么进行，那么现在开放提问，谁有什么问题都可以问！

lines.en: : Miss Imani! Did you know that some people do it in the butt?!
lines.zh: : Imani 老师！您知道吗，有些人是走后门的？！

lines.en: scene eggwar2
: I would now like to close the floor and thank you all for your questions!
lines.zh: : 那么提问环节到此结束，感谢各位的提问！

lines.en: : Way to go, Miku. Now I’ll never know what topics will be covered by the trivia contest and I’ll have to get utterly decimated by Nodoka again.
lines.zh: : 干得漂亮，Miku。这下我永远别想知道知识竞赛会考什么题目了，只能等着再被 Nodoka 碾得体无完肤。

lines.en: : I’d be willing to take a fall for a certain {i}price,{/i} dearest Makoto.
lines.zh: : 只要{i}价钱{/i}合适，我也不介意放放水哦，亲爱的 Makoto。

lines.en: : Why would we pay when we’ve all gotten to see that for free already?
lines.zh: : 既然我们都已经免费看过了，干嘛还要花钱？

lines.en: : Attention! I’m the one in charge here! Which means that everybody has to listen to me! Thanks!
lines.zh: : 注意！这里我说了算！也就是说，所有人都得听我的！谢谢！

lines.en: scene eggwar3
: As you’ve all likely noticed by now, I’m joined today by Class B’s very own Wakana Watabe. Or, as they call her in every other classroom, the hot goth teacher.
lines.zh: : 大家应该已经注意到了，今天我身边还请来了 B 班的 Wakana Watabe。或者说，按其他班的叫法——那位火辣的哥特老师。

lines.en: : That is {i}Miss{/i} Hot Goth Teacher to the lot of you miscreants. Thank you for your cooperation.
lines.zh: : 在你们这帮小混蛋面前，请叫我{i}火辣哥特老师{/i}。感谢配合。

lines.en: scene eggwar4
: Wakana will be popping in throughout the competition to both make sure that I am doing my job and to make sure that all of {i}you{/i} guys are happy! Because, believe it or not, she loves you!
lines.zh: : 比赛期间 Wakana 会时不时露个面，一来监督我有没有好好干活，二来确保{i}你们{/i}大家开开心心！因为，不管你们信不信，她爱你们！

lines.en: : I do not {i}love{/i} them. My livelihood simply hinges on the fact that they need to continue coming here or the school is going to downsize and I’m going to have to ask my parents for financial assistance.
lines.zh: : 我不{i}爱{/i}她们。只是我的生计全靠她们继续来上学，否则学校就要缩编，我就得回去找父母要钱了。

lines.en: : Speaking of parents, has anybody seen Rika? She {i}did{/i} go over all the contests with you, right?
lines.zh: : 说到父母，有人看见 Rika 吗？她应该跟你们把所有比赛项目都{i}讲过了{/i}吧？

lines.en: : I know absolutely no one who goes by that name.
lines.zh: : 我完全不认识叫这个名字的人。

lines.en: : She did, don’t worry. And you’ll probably be happy to hear that she read the script you made basically word-for-word. Perhaps almost...{i}too{/i} word-for-word.
lines.zh: : 讲过了，别担心。而且你听了大概会很高兴——她把你写的稿子基本逐字逐句念了一遍。也许……有点{i}过于{/i}逐字逐句了。

lines.en: : Imani, are you still accepting questions? Because I’m really confused about something.
lines.zh: : Imani，还能提问吗？因为我实在搞不懂一件事。

lines.en: : Yeah, sure. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 当然可以。怎么了？

lines.en: scene eggwar5
: Who are {i}they?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}他们{/i}是谁？

lines.en: scene eggwar6
: Excellent question, Rin!
lines.zh: : 问得好，Rin！

lines.en: : I have absolutely no clue.
lines.zh: : 我完全没有头绪。

lines.en: : But they're clearly breaking the “no boys allowed” rule and better have a damn good explanation as to why!
lines.zh: : 但他们显然违反了「男生禁止入内」的规定，最好给我一个像样的解释！

lines.en: : That’s Good Kid! They’re friends of mine and got really into the Dorm Wars during the Halloween broadcast. So I figured I’d ask them to come give us a live soundtrack this year!
lines.zh: : 那是 Good Kid！他们是我朋友，万圣节那次转播时彻底迷上了宿舍大战。所以我想干脆请他们今年来给我们做现场配乐！

lines.en: : But...they’re white.
lines.zh: : 可是……他们是白人。

lines.en: : Are you a racist now too, Molly?
lines.zh: : 怎么，你现在也成种族主义者了，Molly？

lines.en: : What?! No! I just don’t understand why they’re here in Kumon-mi! Because they’re clearly Canadian and obviously not with that one group of Europeans we’ve encountered.
lines.zh: : 什么？！不是！我只是搞不懂他们为什么会出现在 Kumon-mi！因为他们明摆着是加拿大人，而且显然不是我们之前遇到过的那群欧洲人。

lines.en: : Can people be {i}clearly{/i} Canadian?
lines.zh: : 人能「{i}明摆着{/i}是加拿大人」吗？

lines.en: : Oh, they got trapped inside the wall during a tour and now they can’t leave until everyone comes back from space. They love it, though.
lines.zh: : 哦，他们巡演的时候被困在墙里了，在大家从太空回来之前出不去。不过他们挺乐在其中的。

lines.en: scene eggwar7
: I feel like they’d kind of {i}have{/i} to if they’re going to volunteer to play a free concert at some high school sports day.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，既然他们自愿跑到某所高中的运动会来免费演出，多少{i}也得{/i}乐在其中吧。

lines.en: : What’s even better is that all of their music is totally royalty free! All they want in return for it is to be credited!
lines.zh: : 更棒的是，他们所有的音乐都完全免版税！唯一的要求就是给他们署个名！

lines.en: scene eggwar8
: Why would you say that?!
lines.zh: : 你干嘛要说这种话？！

lines.en: : Don’t you understand that this just means someone {i}else{/i} is going to come along and do this now?! Don’t let them steal our soundtrack! You’re enabling lazy h-game developers everywhere!
lines.zh: : 你难道不明白吗，这样一来{i}别人{/i}也会跑来照做？！别让他们把我们的配乐偷走！你这是在纵容全世界的懒惰 H 游戏开发者！

lines.en: : Oh, stop. As if anyone would ever copy {i}us.{/i}
lines.zh: : 行了，别闹了。好像真有人会抄{i}我们{/i}似的。

lines.en: scene eggwar9
: That’s right, Futaba. I’m sure that anyone watching at home right now would {i}never{/i} do something like that.
lines.zh: : 说得对，Futaba。我相信此刻在家看直播的各位，{i}绝对不会{/i}干出那种事。

lines.en: : Exactly. And if the four of us just happened to be characters in some video game, I’m sure no one would ever go into the game’s code and copy our menus and UI to pass off as their own.
lines.zh: : 没错。而且就算我们四个刚好是某款电子游戏里的角色，我相信也绝对没人会去翻游戏代码，把我们的菜单和界面抄去当自己的。

lines.en: : Or take our music.
lines.zh: : 或者抄我们的音乐。

lines.en: : Or our logo.
lines.zh: : 或者抄我们的 logo。

lines.en: : Or the naming convention of our city.
lines.zh: : 或者抄我们城市的命名方式。

lines.en: : Or key plot points.
lines.zh: : 或者抄关键剧情。

lines.en: : Or character designs.
lines.zh: : 或者抄角色设计。

lines.en: : Yeah. Maybe you’re right, Rin. You’d have to be a real lich to do something like that.
lines.zh: : 是啊。也许你是对的，Rin。能干出这种事的，八成是个真正的巫妖。

lines.en: : But at least you could hide behind the mask of “inspired by” to compensate for and excuse your overwhelming lack of creativity while quietly praying someone will find your knockoff first.
lines.zh: : 但至少你还能躲在「灵感源自」的面具后面，替自己那贫瘠到极点的创造力找补和开脱，同时默默祈祷有人先发现你的山寨货。

lines.en: : Imani, just how long do you intend to let them carry on this ridiculous hypothetical scenario for?
lines.zh: : Imani，你打算让她们把这个荒唐的假设继续演多久？

lines.en: scene eggwar10
: Huh? Did you say something? I couldn’t hear you over that poppy, rocky Good Kid goodness and was too busy following them on Spotify to listen to you.
lines.zh: : 啊？你说话了吗？Good Kid 那又流行又摇滚的美妙音乐盖过了你的声音，我正忙着在 Spotify 上关注他们，没空听你说话。

lines.en: : Can you put your phone down now or am I going to have to rebuild the fourth wall myself?
lines.zh: : 你能不能先把手机放下，还是说这堵第四面墙得由我自己来重建？

lines.en: scene eggwar11
: {i}Hah.{/i} Fine. Fun time’s over, I guess.
lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}。行吧。看来玩闹时间结束了。

lines.en: scene eggwar12
: The name of our first game is Egg Time Madness! Or just “egg toss” if you want to be boring and uncreative!
lines.zh: : 我们第一个项目的名字是「抛蛋狂潮」！如果你想无聊又没创意，也可以叫它「抛鸡蛋」！

lines.en: scene eggwar9
scene eggwar13

: The rules are simple and I’m sure you’ve all played this at least once before, but I’ll go ahead and explain them again for anyone named Touka or Yasu who only recently started talking to real humans.
lines.zh: : 规则很简单，我相信你们之前至少都玩过一次，不过为了 Touka 或者 Yasu 这种最近才开始跟真人说话的同学，我还是再讲一遍。

lines.en: : Oh, thank goodness. I was very concerned for...for Yasu. I obviously know about Egg Time Madness.
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。我刚才还很担心……担心 Yasu。我当然是知道「抛蛋狂潮」的。

lines.en: : Who’s your favorite Egg Time player, Touka?
lines.zh: : 你最喜欢的抛蛋选手是谁呀，Touka？

lines.en: : N...Number seven. From the...from the black team.
lines.zh: : 七……七号。黑队的……黑队的那个。

lines.en: : Imani, how do you manage to deal with these girls on a near-daily basis?
lines.zh: : Imani，你是怎么做到几乎每天都跟这些女生打交道的？

lines.en: : You learn to just tune them out sometimes. But anyway! Rules!
lines.zh: : 有时候你学会直接把她们当背景噪音就行。总之！规则！

lines.en: scene eggwar14
: Two teams of two, one from each floor, will take an egg from Wakana and simply throw that egg back and forth until someone drops it!
lines.zh: : 两人一队、每层各出一队，从 Wakana 手上领一颗鸡蛋，就这么来回抛接，直到有人把蛋摔了为止！

lines.en: : Whoever’s egg stays alive until the end gains a point and takes an early lead in the competition!
lines.zh: : 谁手里的蛋活到最后就得一分，在比赛中取得领先优势！

lines.en: : A...Alive? Are there actually-
lines.zh: : 活……活着？难道说真的有——

lines.en: : Poor choice of words. I bought these eggs from the store. They’re probably not alive. Probably. And if they are, you’ll be pleased to know I kept the receipt and can get my money back.
lines.zh: : 用词不当。这些蛋是我从店里买的，大概不是活的。大概吧。就算真是活的，你们也可以放心——小票我还留着，能退钱。

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s what Sana’s worried about...
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Sana 担心的不是这个……

lines.en: : Now! Which brave combatants are going to be taking the stage first?! And by “stage” I mean dirt. Not even Good Kid gets a stage and they just hit two million followers on Spotify.
lines.zh: : 好了！哪两位勇士要第一个登场？！顺便说一下，我说的「舞台」其实就是泥地。连 Good Kid 都没有舞台，而他们在 Spotify 上刚破了两百万粉丝。

lines.en: : Futaba, can you be my partner for the egg tossing competition?
lines.zh: : Futaba，你能当我的抛蛋比赛搭档吗？

lines.en: : All of the other girls have really tiny hands and I need someone who both excels at protecting things and also has a nurturing presence. I think you’d be really good at it.
lines.zh: : 其他女生的手都太小了，我需要一个既擅长保护东西、又自带抚育气质的人。我觉得你特别合适。

lines.en: : Woah. Did anyone else get really intense deja vu just now?
lines.zh: : 哇哦。有没有人刚才产生了特别强烈的既视感？

lines.en: scene black
: I volunteer myself! And I also volunteer Sana!
lines.zh: : 我自荐！顺便把 Sana 也报名了！

lines.en: : What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : Noooooo my egg!
: Ayane and Sana to the dirt stage! Floor two — choose your fighters!
lines.zh: : Ayane 和 Sana 上泥地舞台！二楼——选出你们的选手！

lines.en: : As if it was ever a choice at all!
lines.zh: : 好像真给过我选择似的！

lines.en: scene eggwar15
: Why am I here?!
lines.zh: : 我为什么会在这里？！

lines.en: : Because, Sana! Everyone always forgets we’re the best of friends and we must seize opportunities like this to remind them all of our combined power!
lines.zh: : 因为啊，Sana！大家总是忘了我们是最好的朋友，我们必须抓住这种机会，让所有人见识见识我们合体的力量！

lines.en: : But I don’t have any power! I can’t even open the door to the storage room! It’s too heavy!
lines.zh: : 可我一点力量都没有！我连储藏室的门都打不开！太重了！

lines.en: : I eat doors for breakfast. Noodle doors. Prepare to die, Zagull Throat Bitch.
lines.zh: : 我早餐吃的就是门。拉面做的门。准备受死吧，Zagull 喉之贱人。

lines.en: scene eggwar16
: That’s not even the right fake name!
lines.zh: : 那个假名根本不对！

lines.en: : Wait. Are you sure you want to compete in this game, Tsuneyo? Doesn’t your experience lie with, like...{i}killing{/i} chickens?
lines.zh: : 等等。你确定要参加这个项目吗，Tsuneyo？你的经验不是在于……{i}杀{/i}鸡吗？

lines.en: : These are not chickens. These are eggs. They came first. I must protect them so that I may one day harvest their meat for ingredients.
lines.zh: : 这不是鸡，是蛋。蛋在鸡之前。我必须保护它们，好让我有朝一日收割它们的肉作为食材。

lines.en: : You dare challenge the Tenderheart Twins? The most esteemed duo of protectors the western leyline has ever seen?
lines.zh: : 你竟敢挑战柔心双子？西部地脉有史以来最受尊崇的守护者二人组？

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, these eggs will never grow into chickens. They’re okay to break.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，这些蛋永远不会孵成鸡。摔碎也没关系的。

lines.en: scene eggwar17
: I have been deceived.
lines.zh: : 我上当了。

lines.en: : D-Don’t listen to her, Kendo Princess! She’s a saboteur! This is all a desperate attempt to debuff our party before the contest begins!
lines.zh: : 别……别听她的，剑道公主！她是破坏者！这一切都是想在比赛开始前给我们的队伍上减益！

lines.en: : No offense, but...you two don’t really...look like twins either...
lines.zh: : 无意冒犯，不过……你们俩看起来也不太像双胞胎……

lines.en: scene eggwar18
: Egad! They’re {i}both{/i} saboteurs! New battle plan, Ram! We’ll focus on curse removal! It’s the only way to combat them!
lines.zh: : 哎呀！她们俩{i}都{/i}是破坏者！新作战计划，Ram！我们专心解除诅咒！这是对抗她们的唯一方法！

lines.en: : I thought you were better than this, Zagull Neck Sword.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你不至于这样呢，Zagull 颈之剑。

lines.en: scene eggwar19
: {i}Come, Emerald Guardian. Let us receive our future child from Miss Hot Goth Teacher.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}来吧，翡翠守护者。我们去从火辣哥特老师手中接过我们未来的孩子。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}For the Tenderhearts! For Ireland!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为了柔心双子！为了爱尔兰！{/i}

lines.en: scene eggwar20
: This shouldn’t be very hard.
lines.zh: : 这应该不难。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think we’ll be okay.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得我们没问题。

lines.en: scene sky
: Places, ladies! At least five yards apart!
lines.zh: : 各就各位，女士们！至少相隔五码！

lines.en: : We must find more yards, Guardian. I am only aware of the one in front of the school.
lines.zh: : 我们得再找几座庭院才行，守护者。我只知道学校前面那一座。

lines.en: : Is here okay, Miss Imai?
lines.zh: : 这里可以吗，Imai 老师？

lines.en: : Yeah, you guys are good. Molly! Further back!
lines.zh: : 嗯，你们没问题。Molly！再往后一点！

lines.en: : My arms are weak! I demand a handicap!
lines.zh: : 我手臂没力气！我要求让分！

lines.en: : I still can not find a second yard. We may have to forfeit at this rate.
lines.zh: : 我还是找不到第二座庭院。照这样下去我们可能得弃权了。

lines.en: : Um...I have the egg. When do we start-
lines.zh: : 呃……蛋在我手上。我们什么时候开始——

lines.en: : Five!
: Oh no! So soon!
lines.zh: : 不好！这么快！

lines.en: : Four!
: It’s okay, Sana! Just like we practiced!
lines.zh: : 没事的，Sana！就像我们练习过的那样！

lines.en: : Three!
: We’ve never practiced this before!
lines.zh: : 我们根本没练过这个啊！

lines.en: : Two!
: Guardian! I will throw the egg as far as I can and hope that it passes more yards along the way!
lines.zh: : 守护者！我要把蛋尽我所能扔远，希望它一路上能经过更多庭院！

lines.en: : One!
: Not those kinds of yards, Tsuneyo! Just throw the egg to me!
lines.zh: : 不是那种庭院，Tsuneyo！把蛋扔给我就行了！

lines.en: : Go! Egg Time Madness!
lines.zh: : 开始！抛蛋狂潮！

lines.en: scene eggwar21
: Egg Time Madness!
lines.zh: : 抛蛋狂潮！

lines.en: scene eggwar22
: Fly!
lines.zh: : 飞吧！

lines.en: : Ah! Ah! Ah! Egg! Help!
lines.zh: : 啊！啊！啊！蛋！救命！

lines.en: scene eggwar23
: Where is it?! Where is it?! It’s blending in with the clouds! It’s-
lines.zh: : 在哪儿？！在哪儿？！它跟云融成一片了！它——

lines.en: scene eggwar24
: Wait. It’s not {i}blending in{/i} at all. I can’t see the egg because it’s {i}invisible!{/i}
lines.zh: : 等等。它根本没{i}融入{/i}什么。我之所以看不见蛋，是因为它是{i}隐形{/i}的！

lines.en: : Of course the Dark Successor would add a twist to such a well-known game. It would be far too easy otherwise! But to think she could get her hands on...Dwarven...egg technology! What a plot twist!
lines.zh: : 黑暗继承者当然会在这个家喻户晓的游戏里加点花样，否则就太简单了！没想到她竟然搞到了……矮人……的造蛋技术！这剧情反转！

lines.en: scene eggwar25
: If the egg is invisible, there is only one way to catch it. I must {i}feel{/i} the egg. I must {i}be{/i} the egg.
lines.zh: : 如果蛋是隐形的，就只有一个办法能接住它。我必须去{i}感受{/i}蛋。我必须{i}成为{/i}蛋。

lines.en: : And an egg...{i}my{/i} egg...
lines.zh: : 而一颗蛋……{i}我的{/i}蛋……

lines.en: scene eggwar26
: ...Would appear before me now!
lines.zh: : ……此刻就会出现在我面前！

lines.en: scene eggwar27
scene eggwar28
: Holy shit, that worked.
lines.zh: : 我操，还真成了。

lines.en: scene eggwar29
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊——！！！！！！！！！！！

lines.en: scene eggwar30
: Sana! Not so hard!
lines.zh: : Sana！轻点！

lines.en: scene eggwar31
: We have to be gentle with the-
lines.zh: : 我们得温柔一点对待这——

lines.en: scene eggwar32
: We have to be gentle with the egg or we’re going to wind up breaking it. Try throwing it underhand. Don’t just whip it at me.
lines.zh: : 我们得温柔地对待这颗蛋，不然会把它摔碎的。试着从下往上抛。别直接朝我砸过来。

lines.en: : It won’t make it to you if I underhand it! Stop assuming I have normal girl strength!
lines.zh: : 我要是从下往上抛，根本到不了你那儿！别总假设我有正常女生的力气！

lines.en: scene eggwar33
: Zagull would never say anything so {i}weak!{/i} Would he, Sana?
lines.zh: : Zagull 绝不会说出这么{i}软弱{/i}的话！对吧，Sana？

lines.en: : Zagull wouldn’t throw eggs in the first place!
lines.zh: : Zagull 一开始就不会去扔鸡蛋！

lines.en: : Well, he would if he still had his dominant hand! So I don’t want to hear you make excuses anymore! Especially not while the Tenderheart Twins are somehow still in this thing!
lines.zh: : 那是因为他惯用的手还在的话就会扔！所以我不想再听你找借口了！尤其是在柔心双子不知怎么还没出局的时候！

lines.en: : I’m trying, okay?! You’re the one who volunteered me for this!
lines.zh: : 我在努力了，好吗？！是你擅自帮我报名的！

lines.en: : Because I believe in you!
lines.zh: : 因为我相信你！

lines.en: scene eggwar34
: The same reason I believe in this egg.
lines.zh: : 和我相信这颗蛋的理由一样。

lines.en: : When we’re born, we’re all defenseless little things. And it’s the people who throw us that make us who we are.
lines.zh: : 我们出生时，都是毫无自卫能力的小东西。是那些把我们抛出去的人，塑造了今天的我们。

lines.en: : It’s the little dreams...like this tiny white ball...and the yellow yolk inside of it that propel us to success.
lines.zh: : 是那些小小的梦想……就像这颗白色的小球……还有里面黄色的蛋黄，推动我们走向成功。

lines.en: : And whenever I hold it in my hands like this...it’s like I’m looking at my future.
lines.zh: : 每当我像这样把它捧在手里……就仿佛在凝视我的未来。

lines.en: scene eggwar35
scene eggwar36
: What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : Ayane! Stop stalling with weird improvised monologues or you’re going to be disqualified!
lines.zh: : Ayane！别再用奇怪的即兴独白拖延时间了，不然你要被判失格了！

lines.en: : I did all I could, Sana! Here comes the future!
lines.zh: : 我已经尽力了，Sana！未来来了！

lines.en: : Don’t just throw time at me!
lines.zh: : 别把「时间」往我这儿扔啊！

lines.en: scene eggwar37
: That’s going to happen whether you like it or not!
lines.zh: : 不管你愿不愿意，它都会发生！

lines.en: : What does that even mean?!
lines.zh: : 这到底是什么意思？！

lines.en: : You’ll find out eventually! Just catch the-
lines.zh: : 你早晚会知道的！接住就是了——

lines.en: scene eggwar38
: Egg...caught!
lines.zh: : 蛋……接住了！

lines.en: : Now, monologue! Quick!
lines.zh: : 快，现在独白！快！

lines.en: : When I...look at the egg, I...I see an egg...
lines.zh: : 当我……看着这颗蛋，我……我看见了一颗蛋……

lines.en: : Throw the damn egg, girl!
lines.zh: : 把那该死的蛋扔过来，丫头！

lines.en: scene eggwar39
: Egg Time Madness!
lines.zh: : 抛蛋狂潮！

lines.en: scene eggwar40
: Egg Time Madness!!!!
lines.zh: : 抛蛋狂潮！！！！

lines.en: scene eggwar41
: Egg Time Madness!!!!!
lines.zh: : 抛蛋狂潮！！！！！

lines.en: scene eggwar42
: Egg Time Madness?!?!?!?
scene eggwar43
: Egg Time Madness.
lines.zh: : 抛蛋狂潮。

lines.en: : Try again, Rin.
lines.zh: : 重来一次，Rin。

lines.en: : Sorry, what I meant to say is- when can we find out what death ball is? Because we’re trying to figure out who is going to compete in what and-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我想说的是——我们什么时候能知道「死亡球」是什么？因为我们在想谁该参加哪个项目，然后——

lines.en: : You’re trying to figure out which girls would be missed the least in the event of an accidental sacrifice?
lines.zh: : 你们是在盘算，万一要献祭，哪些女生最不会被人想念？

lines.en: : Please at least spare Miyamura.
lines.zh: : 至少，请放过 Miyamura。

lines.en: scene eggwar44
: What? No. None of us want to be sacrificed.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。我们谁都不想被献祭。

lines.en: : I mean...no one ever {i}wants{/i} to be sacrificed.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……没人会{i}想{/i}被献祭啊。

lines.en: : We just want to know...what sort of game we should be preparing for. What types of strengths to...incorporate in the team we come up with.
lines.zh: : 我们只是想知道……该为什么样的项目做准备。该把什么样的长处……揉进我们想好的队伍里。

lines.en: scene eggwar45
: You mean you guys, like...you’re actually {i}trying?{/i} Even though there’s not really any {i}reason{/i} to this year?
lines.zh: : 你是说你们……真的在{i}认真打算{/i}？明明今年也没什么{i}理由{/i}要认真？

lines.en: : Of course there is. You worked really hard putting all of this together for us, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 当然有啊。你为了我们这么拼命地筹备这一切，不是吗？

lines.en: scene eggwar46
: You’ve been busting your butt ever since Sensei left. That isn’t lost on us, Miss Imai. The {i}very{/i} least we can do is take this event seriously since we know you’re doing it for {i}us.{/i}
lines.zh: : Sensei 走后你就一直拼死拼活地忙。这些我们都看在眼里，Imai 老师。既然知道你是为{i}我们{/i}做的，我们{i}至少{/i}该认真对待这次活动。

lines.en: : Futaba’s right! We love you and appreciate everything you do for us. Even {i}if{/i} you might make us sacrifice one another later.
lines.zh: : Futaba 说得对！我们爱你，也感谢你为我们做的一切。{i}哪怕{/i}你待会儿可能要让我们互相献祭。

lines.en: scene eggwar47
: Oh, no...I’m gonna cry...Please don’t look at me.
lines.zh: : 哦不……我要哭了……请别看我。

lines.en: : If I wasn’t so dead inside, I’d probably be smiling right now.
lines.zh: : 如果我内心不是已经死了，这会儿大概会笑出来。

lines.en: : You {i}are{/i} smiling right now, Miss Watabe.
lines.zh: : 您现在{i}就在{/i}笑啊，Watabe 老师。

lines.en: scene eggwar48
: No talking back to teachers, Fukuyama. I’ll see you in detention on Monday.
lines.zh: : 不许跟老师顶嘴，Fukuyama。星期一到我这儿来留堂。

lines.en: : D...Detention? Is that...do...do we {i}have{/i} that here?...
lines.zh: : 留……留堂？那是……我们……我们学校{i}有{/i}这个吗？……

lines.en: scene black
: Not nearly as often as we should.
lines.zh: : 远远没有达到应有的频率。

lines.en: scene eggwar39
: Egg Time Madness!
lines.zh: : 抛蛋狂潮！

lines.en: scene eggwar40
: Egg Time Madness!!!!
lines.zh: : 抛蛋狂潮！！！！

lines.en: scene eggwar41
: Egg Time Madness!!!!!
lines.zh: : 抛蛋狂潮！！！！！

lines.en: scene eggwar49
: Monologue-free Egg Time Madness!
lines.zh: : 无独白版抛蛋狂潮！

lines.en: scene eggwar50
: Egg Time-
lines.zh: : 抛蛋狂——

lines.en: scene eggwar51
: Geh!
scene eggwar52
That perfect spring day was the last time Sana Sakakibara would ever open her eyes.
lines.zh: 那个完美的春日，是 Sana Sakakibara 最后一次睁开眼睛。

lines.en: As she collapsed to the ground, her friends rushed to her aid and circled her body.
lines.zh: 她倒在地上时，朋友们纷纷冲上前帮忙，把她团团围住。

lines.en: They lifted her up in hopes that they’d be able to save her life...
lines.zh: 她们把她抬起来，希望能救回她一命……

lines.en: But alas-
lines.zh: 然而可惜——

lines.en: The school nurse is off on Fridays.
lines.zh: 校医星期五休假。

lines.en: She is survived by her mother, Sara Sakakibara, and one other.
lines.zh: 她的遗属是她的母亲 Sara Sakakibara，以及另外一个人。

lines.en: She will be buried next to her brother.
lines.zh: 她将被安葬在她哥哥的身旁。

lines.en: scene eggwar53
Ayane Amamiya never forgave herself for what happened that day.
lines.zh: Ayane Amamiya 从未原谅过那天发生的事。

lines.en: She wound up turning herself in to the police shortly after this for the murder of her best friend and several janitors.
lines.zh: 此后不久，她因谋杀自己最好的朋友和几名校工而向警方自首。

lines.en: The police, having no record of the janitors ever having existed, gave her a light sentence.
lines.zh: 警方查无那几名校工曾经存在过的记录，于是只判了她很轻的刑。

lines.en: She served five years in prison and is now out on parole, working at her father’s bubble-wrap factory.
lines.zh: 她服了五年刑，如今假释出狱，在她父亲的气泡纸工厂上班。

lines.en: She is no longer in contact with anyone.
lines.zh: 她已经和所有人断了联系。

lines.en: scene eggwar54
Molly.
lines.zh: Molly。

lines.en: scene eggwar55
Tsuneyo Tojo, still confused about why she had to be escorted off the street by a classmate, stared at the chickenless egg in her hand and had a thought.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo Tojo 依然搞不懂自己为什么会被同学从马路上架走，她盯着手里那颗没有鸡的蛋，冒出一个念头。

lines.en: But the thought was complicated, and this was not the place to be having it.
lines.zh: 但那个念头很复杂，而现在不是想这个的地方。

lines.en: It had something to do with spiders. Maybe wires. Maybe another recurring symbol that, while confusing to her, would make more sense to someone like you.
lines.zh: 它和蜘蛛有点关系。也许是电线。也许是另一个反复出现的意象——虽然她想不明白，但换成你这样的人，大概会更有感觉。

lines.en: And then you stared at the egg as well.
lines.zh: 然后你也盯着那颗蛋看了起来。

lines.en: And the egg stared back at you.
lines.zh: 而那颗蛋也回盯着你。

lines.en: scene eggwar56
Then Tsuneyo stared back at you.
lines.zh: 接着 Tsuneyo 也回盯着你。

lines.en: scene black
Then the first contest came to an end.
lines.zh: 之后，第一个项目落下了帷幕。
